description: This PHP class defines the EmailSubscriptionModel, which models email subscription data for the OrangeHRM system's admin API. It includes property definitions for serialization and handles an EmailNotification entity.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionModel
classes.description: A model class representing email subscriptions in the OrangeHRM admin API, designed for serialization with associated entity data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmailNotification entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
